```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
```

# Summary

This report summarizes the current filtered dataset in the Shiny app.

```{r}
df <- params$filtered_data
if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
  cat("No data available.")
} else {
  kpi <- list(
    total_paid = sum(df$paid, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_qty = sum(df$approvedquantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_patients = sum(df$patientcount, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  cat(paste0("Total Expenditure: ", dollar(kpi$total_paid), "\\n"))
  cat(paste0("Approved Quantity: ", comma(kpi$total_qty), "\\n"))
  cat(paste0("Patients: ", comma(kpi$total_patients), "\\n"))
}
```

# Top Facilities

```{r}
if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df)) {
  top_facilities <- df %>% group_by(facility_name) %>%
    summarise(Paid = sum(paid, na.rm = TRUE), Patients = sum(patientcount, na.rm = TRUE), Claims = sum(approvedquantity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(Paid)) %>% head(20)
  knitr::kable(top_facilities, caption = "Top 20 Facilities by Paid Amount")
}
```

# Top Clinicians

```{r}
if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df)) {
  top_clinicians <- df %>% group_by(clinician_name) %>%
    summarise(Paid = sum(paid, na.rm = TRUE), Patients = sum(patientcount, na.rm = TRUE), Claims = sum(approvedquantity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(Paid)) %>% head(20)
  knitr::kable(top_clinicians, caption = "Top 20 Clinicians by Paid Amount")
}
```
